facts.fact: In June 2025 the Central Bank of Egypt issued Rules for Licensing and Registration of Payment System Operators and Payment Service Providers, requiring existing institutions to apply for a CBE licence within one year, to June 2026; it also issued governance, internal control and fit-and-proper rules for them under Law No. 194 of 2020.
